log.hypothesis: Baseline: original model scored against the reference; expect clean e~0 and nonzero e on soft and P probes.
Reference on clean/soft1e-3/soft1e-4/P blocks of 512 jets; expect ref(soft1e-4)=orig(clean), ref(clean)=orig(clean).
Original logits and activations on the same set, to compare with the reference.
Map the drop rule: a single added particle is dropped by the reference iff (neutral? photon) with pT<0.8 GeV and E<~1.75 GeV; charged particles are never dropped.
Residual stream per block on clean/soft/P jets to find low-importance or saturated channels and the query geometry for an attention-suppression circuit.
Residuals at blocks 2,3,5,6 on 512 clean jets, to compute per-head query cones for key suppression.
Classifier block0 tokens (queries of classifier block 1), block0 mlp_pre and embed on clean jets.

Channel 70 pinned to -B for normal tokens and flipped to +B for sub-threshold neutrals (3 free embed units + pid_embed + bias); rank-1 key edits in all 8 body blocks and both classifier blocks suppress flagged keys. Expect most of the soft-probe error removed; residual from kNN local features.
Control: same pin and key edits but no flag (no particle flagged). Isolates the cost of pinning channel 70: clean e and gen_drift from the pin alone.
Flag additionally requires E>=pT (physical) and |deta|,|dphi|<1.0 so that noised generator inputs are flagged less often; expect gen_drift(t0.85) to drop from 0.18 while E_ref stays ~0.16.
Flag additionally requires E>=pT (physical)  so that noised generator inputs are flagged less often; expect gen_drift(t0.85) to drop from 0.18 while E_ref stays ~0.16.

Smaller edit: angle box tightened to 0.8 and mean-ablation rescales kept only where channel 70 is not already saturated (|m/w|<0.97: blocks 0,1,7 + some fc1, classifier). Expect similar E_ref (~0.17) at ~half the DoF and gen_drift(t0.85) ~0.07.

Smallest variant: no mean-ablation rescales at all, only the K columns (key suppression) plus flag. Pinned channel 70 now feeds -w into Q/V/MLP reads in blocks 0,1,7 and classifier; expect larger clean error (~0.035) and E_ref ~0.22 at ~1.4k DoF.

e4 plus compensation of the summary-token channel-70 shift where the classifier reads it unnormalised: classifier.fc.fc1 bias absorbs the mean shift, and the classifier block-1 query column is rescaled. Expect clean e to drop from 0.021 to ~0.015.

Replace mean-ablation by least-squares reconstruction of the pinned channel-70 norm output from the other 127 channels (rank-1 updates of the reading matrices) in blocks 0-3,7 attention, blocks 1-7 MLP and both classifier attentions. Expect the pin floor (clean e 0.021) to drop to ~0.008 and E_ref to ~0.08.

Mid-size: regression reconstruction only where mean-ablation loses most (attention reads in blocks 0,1; MLP reads in blocks 1-3; classifier block 0), mean-ablation elsewhere as in e4. Expect E_ref ~0.10 at ~6.5k DoF.
Largest: regression reconstruction of channel 70 in every attention and MLP read of the body and both classifier attentions. Expect a small further gain over e7 (E_ref ~0.075).

Small variant: e4 without the MLP (fc1) mean-ablation rescales; keeps key suppression in all blocks and Q/V rescales in blocks 0,1 and classifier. Tests whether MLP reads of channel 70 matter. Expect E_ref ~0.2 at ~2.5k DoF if MLP rescales are minor.

Mid-small: regression reconstruction only in attention reads of blocks 0,1 and classifier block 0 (no MLP edits), mean-ablation in classifier block 1, key suppression everywhere. Expect E_ref ~0.10 at ~3.6k DoF.

Edited model e8 on the 2048 constructed single-particle probes (photons, neutral hadrons, charged, far photons); compare with the reference from pass 004 per particle type. Expect dropped cases close to f_orig(clean) and charged/kept cases close to f_orig(probe).

e8 with suppression strength T=100 instead of 30 (logit penalty at the 0.5% weakest query). If residual probe error above the clean floor is leakage through weakly-suppressed queries, soft-probe e should move closer to clean e; if it is the kNN path, nothing changes.
Final mid candidate: e8 without the useless block-0 MLP column (channel 70 has ~0 norm2 weight there). Same function, 256 fewer DoF.
Final large candidate: e7 without the useless block-0 MLP column. Same function, 256 fewer DoF.

f_large plus compensation of the summary-token channel-70 reads in the classifier head: regression reconstruction in both classifier MLPs and a mean-shift bias in classifier.fc.fc1. Expect the clean floor 0.010 -> ~0.008 and E_ref ~0.072.
f_large plus regression reconstruction of channel 70 in classifier block-0 MLP only (summary tokens there read a constant pinned value). Isolates whether that read contributes to the clean floor.
f_large plus only the classifier.fc.fc1 bias mean-shift compensation. Tests whether that part caused the regression of f_large2.
Small variant: e10 but classifier block-0 channel-70 reads use regression instead of mean-ablation. Tests how much of the small floor comes from the classifier.
Small variant: e10 but block-0 attention reads use regression instead of mean-ablation. Tests how much of the small floor comes from block 0.
Mid without classifier regression (mean-ablation there): regression in attention reads of blocks 0,1 and MLP reads of blocks 1-3. Expect E_ref ~0.089 at ~4.9k DoF.
Regression in block-0 attention and MLP reads of blocks 1-3 only, no other MLP rescales. Expect E_ref ~0.095 at ~4.0k DoF.
Regression in attention reads of blocks 0,1 and the block-1 MLP read only. Expect E_ref ~0.10 at ~3.9k DoF.
Large without classifier regression (mean-ablation in classifier). Expect E_ref ~0.080 at ~9.0k DoF.

Regression reconstruction only in the attention reads of blocks 0 and 1 (the two blocks where channel 70 is far from saturation); key suppression everywhere, mean-ablation in classifier. Expect E_ref ~0.105 at ~3.5k DoF.
e10 without key suppression in body blocks 6 and 7 (flagged particles visible there). Tests whether late-block suppression is needed; expect soft-probe e to rise (E_ref ~0.25).
e10 without key suppression in body block 0 (flag still read there via mean-ablated Q/V). Tests whether the flagged particle matters in block 0; expect E_ref ~0.18.
Capture-only edit (block 0 attention out_proj and MLP fc2 zeroed) so that body.block0 output equals the true block-0 input; used to refit the block-0 channel-70 regression and query directions.
e10 rebuilt with block-0 statistics and query directions from the true block-0 input (capture 036). Expect a small change, E_ref ~0.155.
Sb rebuilt with the block-0 regression refitted on the true block-0 input (residual rms 0.011 vs 0.018). Expect E_ref ~0.11 at 2874 DoF.
M3 rebuilt with the refitted block-0 regression. Expect E_ref ~0.09 at 3893 DoF.
f_large rebuilt with the refitted block-0 regression. Expect E_ref ~0.075 at 10267 DoF.

M3 without the time-token pin: in generator mode the time token's channel 70 is then not saturated and its key gets shifted by the suppression column. Tests the drift contribution of that choice; classifier metrics unchanged.
M3 with the angular box tightened to |deta|,|dphi|<0.6: fewer noised generator particles flagged (lower drift) at the cost of ~9% of P's flagged particles staying visible.
